title: Consciousness
tagline: Chitta — exploring the depths of awareness
description: Dive deep into the mechanics of consciousness, understanding how thoughts arise and how to find the stillness that lies beneath them.

sutra.meaning:
Yoga is the stilling of the fluctuations of the Consciousness ie Chitta. The Chitta comprises of the Manas, Buddhi, Ahamkar. The mind, intellect and ego.
Then the seer abides in their true nature.

sections.insight:
The mind keeps moving. Awareness—not suppression—brings stillness. Yoga shows us how. 
When the mind settles you experience your true self—peaceful and aware.
sections.reflectionPrompt: When is my mind most restless?
sections.meditation:
3 min breathing. 
Pause and observe moments of stillness . meditate for 10 min
sections.journalPrompt: Did I observe repetitive thoughts? I should watch like I hawk which thoughts are frequent visitors.

sections.gurudevInsight: There are certain vritis of the mind, which are problematic, which causes trouble; difficulties & certain others do not cause any difficulty. Pramanaviparyayavikalpanidrasmruti You call mind or consciousness or chitta – it’s all the same – different modes of consciousness. Five modes of Consciousness arises in your Self. Ya – I see this alps, mountains, water – all this, whatever you see now – these are the proof. Three types of pramana – Pratyaksha – anumana, agama. Our Mind constantly wants to have an obvious, solid experiential proof. [PDF p.9]

sutra.meaning:
There are 5 types of mental modulations
They are- 1.seeking validity of knowledge, 2.perverse or wrong knowledge, 3.imagination or delusion, 4.sleep and 5.memory.

sections.insight:
Some thoughts disturb some don’t. Awareness helps you choose.

"Kleshas (afflictions) in Buddhism are mental

3 min observation
Observe thoughts as helpful/unhelpful. Meditate for 10 min
sections.gurudevInsight: Viparyaya :- Patanjali very beautifully described each of these modulations. Pramana is the knowledge that the mind is constantly engaged in arguments, in proofs, in knowledge, analyzing or wrong knowledge, wrong understanding. This moment there could be arguing, proving there could sbe logic in your mind, looking for a proof or it will have a wrong understanding. You will think things the way they are not. Most of the time you impose your own views & ideas & feelings on others and you think that is how they are not. Most of the time you impose your own views & ideas & feelings on others and you think that is how they are. [PDF p.10]

sutra.meaning: The active fluctuations (vrittis) or manifestations of the mental afflictions (kleshas)—which have been reduced to a subtle state—are to be overcome or eliminated through meditation (dhyana).

sections.insight: Afflictions are of three intensities: gross (sthula), subtle (suksma), and subtlest of the subtle (suksmatama). Tapas, swadhyaya and Ishwara pranidhana erase all of these afflictions.
